packageRules.description: Hold Ruby major bumps: the puppet-module-posix-default-r<minor> and -dev-r<minor> meta-gems are only published for r2.7 and earlier, so CI is pinned to Ruby 2.7 and a Ruby 4.0 bump fails at bundle install. Remove once the Gemfile no longer depends on those meta-gems.
Hold net-ssh at < 8: net-ssh 8 requires openssl >= 3.2, whose frozen SSLContext::DEFAULT_PARAMS makes Puppet 7's monkey patch raise FrozenError on load. Remove once the module moves off Puppet 7.
Hold the CI runner image at ubuntu-24.04: ubuntu 26.04 has no prebuilt Ruby 2.7 for ruby/setup-ruby. Remove once the module moves off Ruby 2.7.
CI is the gate, not semver — every update type auto-merges once required checks are green.
